column1: # Item reactions (shift-click an ITEM that has an ITEM neighbour).
# Each pair of DISTINCT items transmutes into the third one — a 3-item cycle
# so every cross-pair has a rule and shift-click always reacts instead of
# falling through to the id-cycle fallback (ItemCell::interact).
# Semantics of a reaction: the neighbour cell is consumed (becomes EMPTY) and
# the clicked cell becomes `result` with count `resultCount` — both stacks'
